name: opencode-openai-provider
description: OpenCode-adapted @ai-sdk/openai provider fork. Adapting to OpenCode includes absorbing compatible-endpoint tool_search_call (tsc) responses internally, so OpenCode never executes them. Supports OpenCode v1 and v2.

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun build ./src/index.ts ./src/internal/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --external @ai-sdk/provider --external @ai-sdk/provider-utils --external zod && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly --declarationMap false --sourceMap false --outDir dist
scripts.release: bun run build && rm -rf release && mkdir -p release && cp -R dist/. release/ && cp package.json release/
scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run release
